Farm view, rearranged

A proposal on the farm as it renders today; the 3D is untouched. One rule throughout: nothing on the edges reacts to hover. Hovers stay on the farm (a pen) and on charts where they add detail the screen does not already show. Everything else is a click, and every panel opens in the same place on the right.
1 · The bar, 3D and Select
Three things, each in its own place. Top left, the bar sized to what it holds: ‹ goes one level up, the name switches between places at this level, then the panels: Batches, Pigs with how many there are, Devices (a dot in the worst colour inside, red here because the feed line has stopped). Top right, 3D: the camera tools. Bottom right, Select: a mode, not a panel; its actions open beside it (frames 6–8).

5 · Or: Select top right, beside 3D
The other place for it: both buttons that change how you work the farm sit together, top right. Its actions then open at the bottom, away from the button that started them, so bottom right is the pick.

Select, then act

6 · Select: the farm goes to Plan, nothing to act on yet
Actions is no longer a button: every action needs pigs or pens to act on. Select, bottom right, turns on select mode and reads Done while it is on; the farm turns to Plan so pens are easy to hit, and a hint opens beside it, where the actions will appear. Done (or Esc) ends it.
Click pens to select themDone

Plan
7 · Pens picked: their actions appear
Click pens to add or remove them. Beside Done, the card says what is picked and offers only what can be done to it: Treatment, Vaccination, Sampling, Move, Feed, Note, and Culling set apart. Clear empties the pick; Done leaves select mode. Batch-wide things (vaccination plan, batch report, end batch) leave this menu for the batch page.

8 · A pen with many pigs: tick them in its list
Click the pen and its pigs list on the right. Tick pigs (the box, not the row; the row still opens her card) and the same actions open beside Select. Pigs without ID have no box: they can only be acted on with the whole pen, from select mode.

The rest

9 · Devices: the sensors and the equipment, on the right
Equipment is renamed Devices and holds the room readings that used to sit on the bar: temperature, humidity, ammonia first, then climate, fans, lights, drinkers, cameras. Same place and size as Batches and Pigs; a tile opens its card in the same panel, with Back. Ammonia out of range is the amber tile; the stopped feed line is red, so the dot on Devices is red.

11 · At a pen: no pig count; one Performance
At a pen there are no batches, so Batches leaves the bar (her batch is a link on her card); the bar names the pen and Pigs has no count (her card is the panel, shown scrolled to the bottom). Her litters loses its “Performance ›” link; Performance is the button at the bottom, next to Log.

Batch cards

13 · Batch page: the phone’s task card (from last round, for your call)
Each running task says what is happening now in one number (Home’s rules: farrowing underway, then past due, then due today, then the next date) and the days as the phone’s strip. No ring: the ring read as “% done” but counted days.
